title: GWL_FCS30D: global 30 m annual wetland maps, 2000–2022
description: Annual global maps of eight wetland classes at 30 m for 2000 to 2022, produced from Landsat time series by Xiao Zhang, Liangyun Liu and colleagues at the Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences ([paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03143-0)). This mirror converts the producer's yearly zip archives on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/records/10068479) into Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs with embedded colour tables, statistics and overviews, one STAC item per 5° tile per year, and an `items.parquet` index of all items. Pixel values are unchanged. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before you query it.

providers.name: Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences (Liangyun Liu, Xiao Zhang et al.)
providers.description: Produced GWL_FCS30D and publishes it on Zenodo.

providers.name: Portolan Mirrors
providers.description: Maintains this mirror: COG conversion, STAC metadata, item index and documentation.

sci:citation: Liu, L. & Zhang, X. (2023). Time-series global 30 m wetland maps from 2000 to 2022 [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10068479

sci:publications.citation: Zhang, X., Liu, L., Zhao, T., Wang, J., Liu, W. & Chen, X. Global annual wetland dataset at 30 m with a fine classification system from 2000 to 2022. Sci Data 11, 310 (2024). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03143-0

data.title: Wetland class map (COG)
data.description: One band of GWL_FCS30D class codes, uint8, EPSG:4326, about 30 m. The embedded colour table draws the classes; 255 is ocean and is declared nodata.

classification:classes.name: non-wetland
classification:classes.title: Non-wetland
classification:classes.description: Land the producer did not classify as wetland (the classifier's unmask(0) fill).

classification:classes.name: permanent-water
classification:classes.title: Permanent water
classification:classes.description: Retaining water consistently throughout the year

classification:classes.name: swamp
classification:classes.title: Swamp
classification:classes.description: Inland natural wetlands mainly covered by tree vegetation (forest and shrub)

classification:classes.name: marsh
classification:classes.title: Marsh
classification:classes.description: Inland natural wetlands dominated by herbaceous vegetation

classification:classes.name: flooded-flat
classification:classes.title: Flooded flat
classification:classes.description: Non-vegetated inland areas regularly inundated with water, typically during seasonal or periodic flooding events

classification:classes.name: saline
classification:classes.title: Saline
classification:classes.description: High salt concentrations in the area's water, soil, or vegetation

classification:classes.name: mangrove
classification:classes.title: Mangrove forest
classification:classes.description: Salt-tolerant trees and shrubs that grow in brackish water

classification:classes.name: salt-marsh
classification:classes.title: Salt marsh
classification:classes.description: Coastal wetland characterized by salt-tolerant vegetation, typically found in intertidal zones

classification:classes.name: tidal-flat
classification:classes.title: Tidal flat
classification:classes.description: Muddy or rocky areas that are submerged during high tides and exposed during low tides

classification:classes.name: undocumented-188
classification:classes.title: Undocumented code 188
classification:classes.description: Present in the producer's files but absent from their published code list. Meaning unknown.

classification:classes.name: ocean
classification:classes.title: Ocean (not mapped)
classification:classes.description: Ocean, outside the mapped area. Declared nodata in this mirror.

items.title: All items as STAC-GeoParquet
items.description: One row per tile-year item, spatially ordered. Query it instead of walking the tree.

thumbnail.title: Wetland classes in 2022
thumbnail.description: Drawn from the 2022 overview with the embedded colour table.

overview-2022.title: Global overview, 2022 (RGB, Web Mercator)
overview-2022.description: 8-bit RGBA mosaic of the 2022 tiles in EPSG:3857, coloured with the class table. For browsing the coverage, not for analysis.
